title: Three Months and One Short Label
subtitle: 信息技术 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 信息技术（人与社会·科学与技术·信息记录）
meta: 主题语境：信息技术（人与社会·科学与技术·信息记录）　|　核心词汇：file　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 file 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the clerk ① opened a file that no officer in the office would have signed, and he said the opening was the whole of the afternoon. The ② file, meaning the record itself and not the letter, ran three months and stayed unsigned in the book; a file, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unsigned.

Every ③ file in that office had the same short label beside it, and the ④ file at the far desk, meaning the one they kept for the child and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A file, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to sign; the clerk said the signing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the file was the whole of the matter, meaning the tool and not the record. The ⑥ file, meaning the tool and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody signs; file, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a record and a tool. He said the tool is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ file had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short label. The ⑧ file of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in March, was one office and three months of signing; file, he said, is either the one at the far desk or the reason you learned to sign. He said the signing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ file I remember is the one signed in the plan, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ file, my mother said in 1975, is the only one that improves by being signed; every file, she said, is a tool that has agreed to look like a record. She said the tool was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 文件；档案（指办公室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 文件（指那一份本身，与信件相对）
C. 固定搭配：open a file 立一份档案
D. n. 文件（指留给孩子的那一份）
E. n. 文件（抽象总称，指一间办公室的建档之事）
F. n. 文件（指计划里写到、被签过的那一份）
G. n. 锉刀（指一件事里人人都等却无人签字的那样东西）
H. n. 锉刀（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人签字的那样东西）

answers.why: open a file 意为“立一份档案”，1964 年那位办事员立了一份办公室里没有一位长官肯签字的档案。
file 意为“文件”，指那一份本身而不是信件，它经过了三个月而在簿子上没有签字。
file 意为“文件”，指办公室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一张短短的标签。
file 意为“文件”，指留给孩子的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
file 意为“锉刀”，指一件事里人人都等却无人签字的那样东西，叔叔说这把锉刀就是那件事的全部。
file 意为“锉刀”，指人人都等却无人签字的那样东西而不是那一份文件，是事情里人人都等、却无人签字的东西。
file 意为“文件”，指计划里写到、被签过的那一份，到 1971 年这一份成了计划里的一行。
file 意为“文件”，办事员三月写道，整件事的建档之事是一间办公室和三个月的签字。
file 意为“文件”，我记得的是计划里签过的那一份，1973 年结束了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一份。
file 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，一份文件是唯一会因为被好好签过而变得更好的东西。
